purpose: Declarative Source Policy Map that routes every source item for Turkish medical students, interns, residents, physicians, and early-career medical professionals. Not a generic healthcare-news crawler. Authority or viral potential alone never decides publication.
notInScope: Raw legal dumps without impact transform
Life/nöbet culture column as a required early-phase pool
Copying wording/visuals/claims from trend reference accounts
Drug/supplement/treatment-promise advertising as primary revenue content

segments.label: Academic physicians (guest/prestige/source; not primary algorithmic target)
segments.notes: Include only when directly relevant to training, specialty education, or research opportunity.

segments.label: Aspirants for study/residency/postgraduate/work abroad, equivalence and licensing seekers, language-exam candidates
Turkish physicians abroad and those considering return

routes.purpose: Public Instagram/community posts that are both medically relevant and shareable after required transform.
Trusted professional/policy briefings; may stay off-feed or become impact cards only after transform.
Exams, scholarships, exchange, faculty/club opportunities. Rank by eligibility, deadline, medical relevance, official verification — not virality.
Verified congress/scientific meeting opportunities with deadlines and eligibility.
Official pathways for Turkish medical graduates abroad (core: US/UK/DE).
Discovery/trend signals awaiting primary corroboration. Never publish from signal alone.
Out of audience, PR-only, generic exam noise, unverifiable claims, or policy exclusions.

globalRules.audienceOnlyGate: HARD RULE (user, 2026-09-20): the pipeline exists only for physicians, residents, interns and medical students. An item enters review only if it concretely affects that audience (exams, training/specialty, workforce/appointment, regulation, clinical guidance, career/abroad pathways, student opportunities). Anything else is DISCARD before it reaches the Hub. A keyword hit alone is not enough; institutional authority is not enough; a source being sparse is acceptable, a crowded queue is not. When in doubt, discard.
globalRules.neverAuthorityAlone: A source must never be judged only by its institutional authority.
globalRules.neverViralityAlone: A source must never be judged only by viral potential.
globalRules.noInventedEvidence: Every candidate stores decision, source policy applied, evidence status, audience segments, route reason, risk flags, and primary URL when required. Missing evidence → needs-check, discovery-only, or DISCARD — never invent.
globalRules.aiRole: AI may classify and summarize under these controls. AI must never invent evidence or replace a source.
globalRules.lifeCultureColumn: Life/nöbet/faculty-culture is not a required early-phase content column. Allow only published surveys/reports, verifiable training changes, explicit Q&A community posts, or invited first-person pieces when available.
globalRules.facultyAndCuratorRole: Faculty announcements and curated club Instagram retain students (OPPORTUNITY). They are not the account growth engine.

sourcePolicies.label: ÖSYM — medical exams only

score_boosts.when: direct medical-specialty or medical-school exam relevance

score_penalties.when: generic national exam with no medical pathway link

rules: Include only medical-school, medical-specialty, and directly relevant exam items.
Discard generic exam noise.
Convert valid items into what-changed / who-is-affected / deadline / action cards.
Low virality must not reduce OPPORTUNITY priority.

sourcePolicies.label: YÖK / YÖKAK — medical education only

score_boosts.effect: boost medical_relevance; allow FEED only after impact transform

rules: Include only medical education, medical faculty, accreditation, quota, specialty-training, and academic medicine items.
Never publish raw decree text without impact explanation for medical audiences.

sourcePolicies.label: TUK and Official Gazette — primary legal/training change

score_boosts.when: specialty training, rotation, or curriculum change
score_boosts.effect: boost PROFESSIONAL_BRIEF and allow FEED after legal_impact_card

score_penalties.when: raw legal text without impact fields

rules: Treat as primary sources.
Extract the legal or training change, effective date, affected medical audience, and required action.
Never publish raw legal text without an impact explanation.

sourcePolicies.label: Ministry of Health and public-health practice

score_boosts.when: epidemic, vaccination schedule, AMR, patient safety, or workforce rule

rules: Include only items affecting medical training, clinical practice, physician workforce, public-health practice, epidemics, vaccination, screening, patient safety, antimicrobial resistance, environmental health, or digital health.
Exclude PR-only and generic consumer-health campaigns.

sourcePolicies.label: TTB, medical chambers, specialty societies

score_boosts.when: congress, student/resident opportunity, guideline update, professional education, national workforce issue

score_penalties.effect: downgrade to needs-check or DISCARD for FEED

score_penalties.when: local chamber PR with no national medical relevance

rules: Classify advocacy statements as organisation position, not neutral fact.
Require a primary or independent source for factual claims.
Prioritise congresses, student/resident opportunities, guideline updates, professional education, and nationally relevant workforce issues.
Do not mass-ingest every local medical chamber feed in v1.

sourcePolicies.label: Research and AI — Kaduse research sources + PubMed

score_boosts.when: peer-reviewed high-impact finding with clear practical significance

score_penalties.when: preprint or consumer-media summary without corroborating primary evidence
score_penalties.effect: block FEED; TREND_INBOX or DISCARD only

rules: Use Kaduse research sources and PubMed as evidence sources.
Require study design, publication status, limitations, and practical significance.
Preprints or consumer-media summaries cannot become FEED content without corroborating primary evidence.

sourcePolicies.label: Healthline, WebMD, Medical News Today and similar

score_boosts.when: high conversation potential AND linkable primary paper/regulator exists
score_boosts.effect: keep in TREND_INBOX for editorial chase

score_penalties.when: used as sole justification for publication

rules: discovery_only.
They can create a trend candidate but never independently justify publication.

sourcePolicies.label: Faculty announcements and curated tip-club Instagram

score_boosts.when: eligibility + deadline + medical relevance + official page

score_penalties.effect: do not promote above verified opportunities

rules: Route to OPPORTUNITY.
Rank by eligibility, deadline, medical relevance and official verification, not viral potential.
Faculty and curator IG retain students; they are not the growth engine.

sourcePolicies.label: National and international medical congresses

score_penalties.effect: keep commercial_sensitivity separate from editorial ranking

score_penalties.when: no official organizer page or programme/committee

rules: Accept only official organizer pages with a verified programme or scientific committee.
Capture student/resident eligibility, abstract calls, travel grants and deadlines.
Keep sponsored placement separate from editorial ranking.

sourcePolicies.label: Abroad career — US, UK, Germany official pathways

score_boosts.when: official requirement/date change for US/UK/DE pathways

score_penalties.when: blog, influencer, or consultancy as claimed primary
score_penalties.effect: force DISCARD as primary; at most TREND_INBOX signal

rules: Core countries: United States, United Kingdom, Germany.
Use official regulators, exam bodies, universities and government sources only.
No blog, influencer, or consultancy may serve as the primary source.

sourcePolicies.label: Gulf/Saudi abroad pathways — watch-only v1
rules: Gulf/Saudi: watch-only in v1.
Official regulators only; do not promote as core pathway until policy review.

sourcePolicies.label: Trusted Trend Radar + Question Demand Radar

score_boosts.when: trusted official/scientific/professional source AND independent primary_url

score_penalties.when: social, Google Trends, Reddit, forum, consumer health or search trend alone
score_penalties.effect: QUESTION_BRIEF / Question Demand Signal only — never TREND_CANDIDATE

score_penalties.when: copying wording, visuals, claims, or videos from reference accounts

rules: Canonical detail: content/policies/hekimler-trusted-trend-question-demand-policy.json
Only pre-approved official, scientific, professional or high-quality editorial sources may create a Trend Candidate.
Social posts, Google Trends, Reddit, forums, comments, consumer health articles and Turkish search trends never create a Trend Candidate by themselves — Question Demand Signals / QUESTION_BRIEF only.
Official social may point to a topic; official website, study, guideline or regulator notice remains required as primary_url.
No question or demand signal becomes content without independent scientific, official or primary evidence.
Never copy wording, visuals, claims, or videos from reference accounts.

may: Classify item against include/exclude keywords and source policy id
Summarize what-changed / who-is-affected for transform cards
mustNot: Invent citations, dates, deadlines, eligibility, statistics, or quotes
Treat discovery_only media as primary evidence
Publish or recommend FEED without required_transform completion
Replace a source URL with model memory

designIndependence: This file encodes source routing and evidence policy only. It does not encode layout, typography, art direction, or composition.
